title: Building a Production Greek-English Speech Recognizer
abstract: arXiv:2609.13498v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We report a multi-month engineering program to build Sophea, a production bilingual Greek-English automatic speech recognition system. We evaluate the system against nine production gates covering Greek and English word error rate, language identification, and hallucinations on non-speech audio. Across twenty-three training iterations and two model architectures, no training-data composition passed all nine gates simultaneously. Meeting the Greek noisy-environment target required about 1,500 steps of dense domain exposure, while preserving English language identification tolerated only about 250 steps, or about 1,250 with a rebalanced mix that reduced Greek accuracy. We describe a six-stage data pipeline in which calibrating an audio-quality filter against in-domain anchors reduced the discarded share of scored Greek audio from 98.7 percent to 10.6 percent. A pre-registered ablation isolated a hallucination defect to one training-data

translated_title: 构建生产级希腊语-英语语音识别器
translated_abstract: 我们报告了一项为期数月的工程项目，旨在构建 Sophea——一个生产级希腊语-英语双语自动语音识别系统。我们针对九项生产门控指标对系统进行了评估，涵盖希腊语和英语的词错误率、语言识别以及在非语音音频上的幻觉问题。经过二十三次训练迭代和两种模型架构的测试，没有任何一种训练数据组合能够同时通过全部九项门控。要达到希腊语嘈杂环境的目标需要约 1,500 步的密集领域暴露，而要保持英语语言识别能力仅能容忍约 250 步，或在重新平衡混合比例的条件下容忍约 1,250 步（但这会降低希腊语准确率）。我们描述了一个六阶段数据流水线，其中通过将音频质量过滤器与领域内锚点进行校准，使被丢弃的评分希腊语音频比例从 98.7% 降低到 10.6%。一项预先注册的消融实验将一个幻觉缺陷隔离至某一训练数据（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文报告了构建生产级希腊语-英语双语语音识别系统 Sophea 的多月工程实践，揭示了九项生产门控无法通过任何单一训练数据组合同时满足的希腊语-英语性能权衡，并通过将音频质量过滤器与领域内锚点校准，将希腊语音频丢弃率从 98.7% 大幅降至 10.6%。
en_tdlr: This paper reports a months-long engineering effort to build Sophea, a production bilingual Greek-English speech recognition system, revealing that no single training-data composition could pass all nine production gates simultaneously due to Greek-English performance trade-offs, while achieving a reduction in discarded Greek audio from 98.7% to 10.6% by calibrating an audio-quality filter against in-domain anchors.
